newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Ceylon Holiday dips on retail sell-off.
newsitem.headline: Ceylon Holiday dips on retail sell-off.

text.p: Shares of Ceylon Holiday Resorts Ltd fell 6.17 percent or 2.50 rupees to 38, on retail profit-taking on Thursday, brokers said.
"Small investors are taking profit in the share which rose on the back of a revival in tourism," said a local broker.
The government tourist board said tourist traffic rose by 15 percent in the first two months of 1997, compared to a 26 percent fall in 1996.
The firm, a unit of the blue chip John Keells Holdings Ltd, owns and operates three hotels in southern Sri Lanka.
